about.title: Duarte Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: Duarte is a small city — about 21,990 people — and when one of them dies because of someone else's carelessness, the loss ripples through many households at once. In 2025, public records list 69 injury collisions in Duarte, 81 people hurt, and one traffic death. Collision counts run highest along the I-210 Foothill Freeway, Huntington Drive, and Buena Vista Street, and reported crashes tend to peak on Friday afternoons between 4 and 6 p.m. Not every wrongful death begins on a road. A fall at a property, a medical error, or a workplace incident can give rise to the same kind of civil claim. California limits who may bring the case — a spouse or domestic partner and children come first — and it sets a two-year clock from the date of death, with a much shorter window when a public agency is involved. LawProactive is not a law firm. We connect Duarte families with an independent attorney who handles these cases on contingency, so there is nothing to pay unless there is a recovery.

whyChoose.title: Why Duarte Families Turn to LawProactive

items.title: Clarity on who can file
items.desc: California gives a surviving spouse or domestic partner and children the first right to bring a wrongful death action, with certain dependents and heirs eligible in other situations. The attorney we connect you with can sort out standing early so nothing is filed by the wrong person.

items.title: The deadline is watched for you
items.desc: Most wrongful death claims must be filed within two years of the date of death, and the window shrinks considerably if a city, county, or state agency may share responsibility. Getting matched promptly keeps those dates from slipping past while your family is grieving.

items.title: Every recoverable loss is considered
items.desc: A claim can seek funeral and burial expenses, the financial support your loved one would have provided, and the loss of their love, companionship, and guidance. Network attorneys work on contingency, so you pay no fee unless there is a recovery.

items.question: My family member was killed in a crash on the I-210 near Duarte. Does the police investigation decide our case?
items.answer: No. A criminal investigation or prosecution is handled by the state, while a wrongful death claim is a separate civil action your family controls. The two can run at the same time, and a civil claim can move forward even if no charges are ever filed. Crash reports and CHP findings can still be useful evidence in the civil matter.

items.question: Who in our family is allowed to bring a wrongful death claim in California?
items.answer: The law puts a surviving spouse or registered domestic partner and the children first in line. If there is no one in that group, certain other heirs or people who were financially dependent on the deceased may be able to file. An independent attorney can review your specific family situation and explain who qualifies.

items.question: How long do we have to act after a death in Duarte?
items.answer: Generally two years from the date of death for a claim against a private person or business. If a government entity — such as Los Angeles County, the City of Duarte, or Caltrans — may be responsible, a formal claim usually has to be presented within six months, which is far shorter. Because that clock is unforgiving, it is wise to speak with an attorney sooner rather than later.
